decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's dental lab material and custom-manufacturing knowledge, so the firm can readily interpret results and improve the product.
PETG thermoforming blanks are closely related to existing dental material and thermoforming capabilities, supporting the firm's ability to assimilate and apply new information.
Custom hearing protection earmolds draw on the firm's earmold and hearing-care knowledge but are less central, so the firm can learn from early results yet faces higher uncertainty.
